title: CVDI Human Disease Portal Home
bodyHtml:
An update using newer phenotype libraries, updated phenotype data, and additional WGS samples is available in Results (V2). If you are interested in using these data, please email sjurgens@broadinstitute.org.

 

This website hosts rare coding variant gene-level associations from sequencing data for 601 diseases across 748,879 individuals, from the publication:

Rare coding variant analysis for human diseases across biobanks and ancestries.
Jurgens SJ, Wang X, et al.
Nat Genet. 2024 Sep;56(9):1811-1820. doi: 10.1038/s41588-024-01894-5.
PMID: 39210047

To access publicly available cohorts (v1), go to Results.

Example results for UBR3 and Cardiomyopathy in the trans-ancestry UK Biobank, MGB and AllofUs cohorts (v1, corrected for overlapping samples).

Download gene-level association scores and README
